# Hedge Wears

> Hedge Wears (legal entity: Hedge Wearsly Limited) is a modern African fashion house. It designs, curates, and sells premium clothing, footwear, and accessories for men and women — blending African heritage with timeless, seasonless design. This site (hedgewears.com) is the official marketing website: it tells the brand story, showcases collections, categories, and featured products, and sends shoppers to the Hedge Wears web store and mobile apps. Prices are shown in HedgeCoin (HGC — an in-platform loyalty currency), with a local-currency equivalent always in view.

## What Hedge Wears is
- A premium African fashion brand headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, selling globally to Africa and the diaspora.
- Tagline: "We don't just wear fashion — we Hedge it." / "Style Beyond Seasons."
- Not fast fashion: classic, culturally rooted, timeless design built to outlast trends.
- Sells apparel (shirts, polos, long-sleeve tops, trousers), footwear (sneakers, loafers, oxfords, boots, mules), and accessories (watches, chains, bangles, rings, necklaces, glasses) for men and women.
- Brand value framework (C.R.E.S.T.): Classic, Rooted (in African heritage), Empowering, Stylish, Timeless.

## How shopping works
- Browse collections, categories, and featured products on this site, then continue to the Hedge Wears web store or the mobile app to buy.
- Each product shows photos/video, a price in HGC, size/colour variants, and customer reviews.
- Prices are shown primarily in HedgeCoin (HGC), with a secondary equivalent in the shopper's selected local currency (150+ currencies supported; default Nigerian Naira / NGN).
- Payments are processed through Paystack (debit/credit card or bank transfer). Card details are never stored on Hedge Wears servers.
- After ordering: track order status (Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Delivered), request returns where eligible, and leave product reviews.

## HedgeCoin (HGC)
- HGC is the currency Hedge Wears uses to price and sell products — an in-platform loyalty/wallet currency, NOT a cryptocurrency.
- You fund your HGC balance from your local currency; the rate and any fees are shown before you confirm, and HGC can be converted back.
- Prices are always coin-first; local-currency amounts are a muted secondary estimate.

## Platform & apps
- Hedge Wears runs on the Vendorstack coin/commerce infrastructure that powers the platform.
- Available as: this marketing site (hedgewears.com), the Hedge Wears web store, and native iOS and Android apps.
